messages.subject: Using MIRTCAT for Psychosocial Screening on Phones or Tablets
parts:
Hi all,

My lab is looking into how we might use MIRTCAT for psychosocial screening in our local pediatric diabetes clinic. If anyone has thoughts about this possibility (or better yet, has successfully done something like this), using smaller devices and public hosting (or interfacing with REDCAP or qualtrics), I would love to chat back channel about this and collaborate if interested. My email is ksberlin @ memphis.edu .Thanks!

Kris

(Kristoffer Berlin, The University of Memphis).
